topic: Removal of loose rivets structural repair on aircraft structure
syllabus_extract: Removal of loose rivets structural repair on aircraft structure
specific_objectives: 31.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to perform various repair works on aircraft structure

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of loose rivet removal using drill and hammer; Safety precautions include PPE and fire watch; Instructor supervision required during drilling.
intro_questions: What are the common causes of loose rivets in aircraft structures?
Why is it critical to remove loose rivets before applying new repair?
List three safety precautions required before starting rivet removal.

development.content:
Identification of loose rivets
Preparation of work area
Selection of removal tools
Drilling technique for removal
Cleaning of rivet holes

Inspection of surrounding structure
Removal of damaged skin
Preparation of new rivets
Installation of new rivets
Final inspection and torque check

Documentation of repair
Marking of repaired area
Reporting of defects
Storage of removed parts
Tool cleanup and return

summary_questions: Explain the correct sequence for removing a loose rivet without damaging the surrounding skin.
Describe the steps required to prepare a new rivet for installation after removing a loose one.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the tools and materials required for structural repair, referencing LP 02.
